light_curve.description: Four aperture light curves, three processing levels and errors/quality, sky, flux-weighted RA/Dec centroids, and parent FFI names; header has no narrative blend attribution.

dv.review_method: Both pages rendered and visually inspected; PDF content is raster and text extraction is almost empty. Values below are manual transcription, not OCR-derived measurements.

page2.description: Gaia stellar field with four dotted aperture circles and aperture-dependent centroid-motion ellipses. Ellipses have different positions, most conspicuously the 4-pixel ellipse. No text identifies KIC 10014830 as the source or certifies absence of contamination.

interpretation: The 2020 DIAmante method defines Mahalanobis rank 1 when the target is the nearest Gaia source to that aperture centroid-motion distribution, and 0 when another source is selected. Thus the public DV already has a non-target 4-pixel centroid association, with target associations in the smaller three apertures. It does not name the selected other star as KIC 10014830. Montalto 2022 defines the adjacent-aperture depth statistic and used a cutoff apstat<5; this target's 4.33 is below that cut. These are pre-existing aperture/centroid diagnostics, not a new r32 attribution or an FPP.
